scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and separately reproducible finite checks; no independent external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Pure degree-two real spherical harmonics, pair of exactly antipodal spherical caps, dimension d>=3, and 0<t<1 only; not full low-pass spectral bands. General Slepian matrix methods predate this sharp crossing. Equivalence to unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp quadrupole Slepian transition for antipodal spherical caps
